name: patch_check
author: OpenAgents
description: Check whether a unified diff or patch still applies to a file's current content, and where it drifts. Use it before claiming a diff applies cleanly: it validates each hunk against the text you pass in, reports the line each hunk lands on, the signed drift when a hunk placed off its declared position, and why a hunk failed (context_not_found or ambiguous, quoting the first mismatching context line). Pure computation with no file, network, or environment access — both the diff and the file content arrive as input. One file per call; optionally returns a bounded preview of the post-application content.

diff.description: The unified diff to check: one file, one or more @@ hunks. A diff naming multiple files is refused.

content.description: The file's current text, checked as-is.

fuzz.description: Max line-offset drift searched when exact placement fails. Default 200, capped at 1000.

whitespace_lenient.description: When true, context lines match ignoring trailing whitespace. Default false.

include_preview.description: When true and every hunk applies, return the post-application content. Default false.

max_preview_chars.description: Character ceiling for the preview; longer previews are elided in the middle with a '[N chars elided]' marker. Default 20000, capped at 100000.

at_line.description: Where the hunk's old side sits, 1-based in the current content.

drift_lines.description: Signed line offset from the declared position, present only when the hunk placed off it.

reason.description: Why the hunk did not place.

mismatch.description: The first old-side line that no longer matches, bounded to 200 characters.

preview.description: The post-application content, present only when include_preview was set and every hunk applies.

preview_truncated.description: True when the preview was elided in the middle past max_preview_chars.
